text_blocks.snippet: India's COVID-19 vaccination program began on January 16, 2021, with over 2.2 billion doses administered as of March 4, 2023. Several vaccines have been approved and used, including Covishield, Covaxin, Sputnik V, Corbevax, and Covovax, with Sputnik Light also approved for emergency use. The government has actively addressed concerns about vaccine safety, refuting claims of links between vaccines and sudden heart-related deaths, according to a YouTube video from the Health Ministry.

list.title: Government Response to Safety Concerns:
